panels.scene: A farmer stands in his small but beautiful field. The sun shines brightly in the sky above.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργός ἐστιν ἀγαθὸς καὶ ἰσχυρὸς ἄνθρωπος.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer is a good and strong person.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor es una persona buena y fuerte.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik jest dobrym i silnym człowiekiem.

panels.scene: The farmer digs his field. He spots a large stone embedded in the ground.
panels.greekCaption: σκάπτει τὸν ἀγρόν. βλέπει τὸν μέγαν λίθον.
panels.englishCaption: He digs the field. He sees the large stone.

captionTranslations.es: Cava el campo. Ve la piedra grande.

panels.scene: He lifts the great stone and carries it out of the field. His strength is on full display.
panels.greekCaption: αἴρει τὸν μέγαν λίθον καὶ φέρει. ἰσχυρὸς γάρ ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: He lifts the large stone and carries it. For he is strong.

captionTranslations.es: Levanta la piedra grande y la lleva. Pues es fuerte.
captionTranslations.pl: Podnosi wielki kamień i niesie go. Bo jest silny.

panels.scene: The farmer rests under an olive tree by the river. He looks up and gives thanks to God.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ βίος καλός ἐστιν ὅτι ὁ θεός ἐστιν ἀγαθὸς καὶ πιστός.
panels.englishCaption: Life is good because God is good and faithful.

captionTranslations.es: La vida es buena porque Dios es bueno y fiel.
captionTranslations.pl: Życie jest dobre, bo Bóg jest dobry i wierny.

panels.scene: The day's work is done. The farmer walks out of his house early in the morning to begin his labor.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς ἐκβαίνει ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου. ὁ πόνος χαλεπός ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer goes out of the house. The labor is hard.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor sale de la casa. El trabajo es duro.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik wychodzi z domu. Trud jest ciężki.

panels.scene: He walks around the field, checking the crops. He rests briefly by the river.
panels.greekCaption: περιπατεῖ ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ καὶ ἡσυχάζει ἐγγὺς τοῦ ποταμοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: He walks around the field and rests near the river.

captionTranslations.es: Camina por el campo y descansa cerca del río.
captionTranslations.pl: Chodzi po polu i odpoczywa nad rzeką.

panels.scene: At the end of a long day of labor, the farmer sits inside his house, content and thankful.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς καθίζει ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ καὶ εὐχαριστεῖ τῷ θεῷ.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer sits in the house and gives thanks to God.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor se sienta en la casa y da gracias a Dios.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik siada w domu i dziękuje Bogu.
